prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Image 3 is the APPROVED LOOK of this exact boss in its idle pose (pixel art). Keep the identical design, armour, colours, proportions and size; only the pose changes.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: Chaos, exactly as in Image 3: the same colossal titan of cracked black obsidian on two thick legs, exactly four arms (two on each side) with huge clawed stone hands, the same tattered wings of shadow-flame, the horned obsidian crown, the cracked stone face with two burning white eyes, and the glowing seams in frost cyan, ember orange, abyss teal and storm white. FACE: the cracked obsidian face with two burning white eyes under the horned crown is readable.

Pose: a crushing double blow, seen in the same front view as Image 3 (chest and face toward the viewer, never in side profile), the body leaning toward the heroes on the right over a planted front leg, both wings flaring. Exactly four arms, all four clearly visible and separate: on the right side of the image, the upper arm and the lower arm both swing down in front of the body, their two fists smashing down together low toward the heroes; on the left side of the image, the upper arm is thrown back up behind the shoulder and the lower arm is braced at the hip, both clearly visible beside the body; at the same pixel size as in Image 3, facing right.

MOVEMENT: this is a dramatic ACTION frame of a huge, intimidating boss, not a static stance. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso, extend the arms and weapon far from the body, and let hair, cloth or a cape move with the motion. The silhouette must be very different from the idle reference. Any part of the body or weapon may reach beyond the sides of the grey box. BODY: standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, goat legs, hooves, a tail, snakes, a cape, a weapon, fur, two arms, six arms, a second head.
